title: Thread history
responsibility: Shows entity events and lets a person choose a plan or design version.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.entity
inputs.description: Entity history, versions, category, identifier and title. Functions show plan versions without image requests; other categories may show each version’s first relevant image.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplied to version thumbnails for image retrieval.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.version
inputs.description: Required current version for highlighting and choosing its currently viewed option thumbnail.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.option
inputs.description: Optional current-version option, empty by default. Other versions use their approved or first option through the helper.

inputs.name: ThreadHistory.select
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the clicked version. Does not itself mutate the version prop.

outputs.name: ThreadHistory
outputs.description: Expandable event history with titles, raw recorded timestamps and details, plus a selectable version strip. Empty history is explicit. Versions show thumbnails where applicable and Plan/Design or approval labels. An approval tied to a known option names that option.
